files.rationale: Kept PR B's syntax-only helpers, validate_* utilities, validate-aware parse_input/parse_output/parse_global and parse(cli, validate=True) (which still loads the filter dict so audio filters type correctly), together with PR A's optional-filter parse_filter_complex, parse_cli and parse_with_validation, which now passes validate_options to the sub-parsers so that parse_cli never loads the options or filter dictionaries.
